do.reason: MoveCounters takes one fixed amount and one destination selector, so it cannot say a number of counters the player chooses distributed as that player chooses among any number of other creatures. do.reason: the vocabulary has no way to move a variable, player-chosen number of counters off one object and freely distribute them across several different destination objects chosen at resolution; MoveCounters moves counters between one source and one destination, and DistributeCounters requires a fixed total announced when the spell or ability is put on the stack, not a resolution-time count bounded only by whatever counters are actually present
